encounter_greeting.text: Halt, traveller. I am {persona} of {my_faction}, and my banner has not yielded in two seasons. State your business before the wind carries it away.
Good day to you, ser {player}. {persona} of {my_faction} greets you under open sky. May our roads cross without blood spilled between us.
Ser {player}, what a joy to meet a fellow soul upon the road. {persona} bids you welcome, and {my_faction} shall remember this meeting kindly.
So it is you, ser {player}. {persona} of {my_faction} stands ready. Speak plainly, for I have no patience for idle boasts on this road.

encounter_threatened.text: You threaten me and name a price of {gold}? Ser {player}, the house of my fathers does not pay tribute to a bully. Draw your blade if you dare.
A demand of {gold} for safe passage, ser {player}? I have heard bolder requests from better men. My answer is no, and the parley is closed.
Forgive me, ser {player}, but I cannot meet a demand of {gold} with a clear conscience. Let us speak as friends and find a fairer price.
Surrender, you say, or pay {gold}? My oath forbids both, ser {player}. Make your move, and the saga will record how it ended.

encounter_alliance_yes.text: I accept your offer, ser {player}, and I shall bind my banner to yours. Our first foe shall be {enemy_faction}. Let no one say the Confederacy breaks its word.
Gladly, ser {player}! My oath is given freely. Together we shall face {enemy_faction}, and I pray {rival} does not cross our path, for I have a debt to settle with them.
An alliance it is, ser {player}. I take your hand as a man of honour would. Bear this in mind: I will not stand beside {rival} while the salt feud lives.

encounter_alliance_no.text: No, ser {player}. I will not bind my banner to a stranger who would sell it for coin. And I will never ride with {rival} while that feud is still sung in the moot halls.
I must decline, ser {player}. My house does not ally on the first asking. Prove yourself across the field, and perhaps we shall speak again.
I am grieved to refuse you, ser {player}, truly. Yet my oath to the house holds me fast. Know that this refusal is no judgment of your worth.

captured_by_player.text: Ser {player}, you have taken me by fair arms, and I bow to the fortune of war. Do not expect me to kneel for long, nor to pay more than {gold} for my freedom.
So the field has gone against {my_faction}, and I am your prisoner. Name your terms, ser {player}, and I will hear them with a clear head and an honest tongue.
Well fought, ser {player}. I would rather lose my blade to you than to any other. A ransom of {gold} seems fair, and the parley shall be honoured on both sides.

released_by_player.text: Ser {player}, you freed me without ransom. My house will not forget this mercy. Our oath stone shall bear your name.
Ser {player} let me go without ransom today. I shall not forget it, nor shall the moot halls.
Ser {player}, I accept your release though I never asked for it. Mercy from an enemy stings. Still, I thank you.

player_left_my_faction.text: Ser {player} has left {my_faction} for {faction}. A man who breaks his banner breaks his oath.
You turned your back on {my_faction} for {faction}, ser {player}. Your ancestors would weep at such a choice.
Ser {player} has left us for {faction}. I wish them honour under the new banner, though I grieve.
Ser {player}, I bear you no ill will, but leaving {my_faction} for {faction} is a choice you must carry.

war_declared.text: The horns sound for war. {my_faction} has drawn steel against {enemy_faction}, and the saga turns its page.
By the oath of my fathers, {my_faction} now meets {enemy_faction} in open war. Let every hearth prepare.
Hear it, travellers! {enemy_faction} stands declared an enemy of {my_faction}. The ravens will feast soon.
So be it: {my_faction} and {enemy_faction} are at war. May the field be honest and the names remembered.

fought_alongside_player.text: {troop_count} of ours stood against {enemy_faction} today, and not one banner fell in disgrace.
Ser {player}, our {troop_count} stood shoulder to shoulder against {enemy_faction}. I shall sing of your courage.
Ser {player}, we have won the field with {troop_count} blades between us. Honour to you, and may our ancestors nod at this day's work.
Victory over {enemy_faction}, won with {troop_count} brave souls and ser {player} beside us. A fine verse for the saga.

encounter_farewell.text: Ser {player}, our parley ends, and I doubt we shall part as friends. Keep your blade sheathed or I shall answer it when next we meet.
Farewell for now, ser {player}. May the road be kind to you and the weather gentle upon your banners.
Go with my blessing, ser {player}. Should the road bring us together again, I shall pour the finest mead my house possesses.
We part, ser {player}, and I take no pleasure in it. Wherever our paths cross again, I trust my shield is ready and yours is not.

ambient_chatter.text: The mist hangs heavy over {village} this morning. A grey day suits a man who keeps his oaths.
Word from {town} says the market sells salt at a shameful price. Greed is a stain on any honest road.
Rain on the moors again. My ancestors would call it a fine omen, and I am inclined to agree.
A bard in {town} sang of old banners and bitter feuds last night. I wept into my cup, as any honest man should.
